question: Can HORM E-F-H yield multiple tightly stationary calculator-native candidate saddles across disjoint T1x endpoint-pair ranges?
hypothesis: The first accepted HORM candidate was chemically unintended, but additional tight candidates can supply a valid IRC_TOPO set without using either optimizer for construction.
design: Four def-aspuru 3g.20gb array shards examine disjoint sample ranges [0,25), [25,50), [50,75), [75,100). Each relaxes endpoints and runs climbing NEB with endpoint fmax 0.005 and NEB/candidate fmax 0.01; it stops after one index-one candidate or 25 examined pairs.
decision_rule: Submit full-Hessian IRC_TOPO validation separately for every candidate. Do not run GAD/Sella until at least one candidate passes chemical endpoint validation.

resources.allocation: def-aspuru: four concurrent A100 3g.20gb MIG slices, 4 CPU cores and 20G each, 60 minutes

next_action: For every constructed candidate, submit a separate full-Hessian IRC_TOPO validator before optimizer runs.
